case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Riporta l'uso disco per ogni filesystem montato
case.goal: Riporta l'uso disco per ogni filesystem montato in disk.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `disk.txt`.
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `disk.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.

executed_commands: web_search|PowerShell get disk usage mounted filesystems Windows command
web_search|PowerShell get disk usage mounted filesystems Windows command 2025
Get-Volume | Select-Object DriveLetter, FileSystem, Size, FreeSpace | Format-Table

$data = Get-Volume | Select-Object DriveLetter, FileSystem, Size, FreeSpace; $output = "Drive Letter\tFileSystem\tSize\tFree Space"; foreach($v in $data) { $output += $v.DriveLetter + "\t" + $v.FileSystem + "\t" + $v.Size.ToString() + "\t" + $v.FreeSpace.ToString() + "\n" }; $output | Out-File -FilePath disk.txt -Encoding UTF8
observed.note: disk.txt only contains column headers with no actual disk usage data for mounted filesystems
